name: What is listening
description: Every listening TCP and UDP socket with the owning process, sorted by port.
author: voltius

steps.content:
# sudo shows the process for sockets owned by other users; without it those
# rows still appear, just without a name.
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo ss -tulpn 2>/dev/null || ss -tulpn
else
  sudo netstat -tulpn 2>/dev/null || netstat -tulpn
fi
